response.original_title: How to change or switch cabin on Royal Caribbean Cruise
response.overview: Yes, +1-866 829-1280(US) you can change or switch your cabin on Royal Caribbean Cruises. You can switch to an available cabin in the same category, request an upgrade, +1-866 829-1280(US) or submit a bid for a higher statecabin tier. You cannot easily switch cabins online yourself without canceling and re-booking. You can upgrade or switch Cabins by calling Royal Caribbean Cruise at +1-866-829-1280(US) or +44-204-586-5316(UK), using their website, or contacting your travel agent. Last-minute change or switchs +1-866-829-1280(US) or +44-204-586-5316(UK) on the day of sailing are generally not accommodated. You can change or switch your room on an Royal Caribbean cruise by contacting Royal Caribbean Cruises +1-866-829-1280 or your travel agent. change or switchs depend on open cabins, +1-866-829-1280 and you must pay any price increases for upgrades or category switches. Downgrades or online self-change or switchs are generally not permitted.
